design: Two prespecified 20-chain checks, one second per chain, one worker, 1500 separate warmup iterations and 1500x2000 VI draws per map; fit/chain seeds 42/901001 and 43/902001.
limits: Short checks, not full-paper evidence or a universal ranking.
New BW random-number construction preserves the transition law but changes seeded warmup and production paths; changes in MSE are not solely a speed effect.
Use jax_dcs_efficiency_benchmark.json for the fixed-work, fixed-map, fixed-scale implementation speed comparison.
Each run is conditional on one fitted ball and sphere map.
